usedFor: Ploomes holds contacts and deals, and Google Docs receives their details through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Deal” in Ploomes, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new deal can fill a document tab with its details, so the paperwork starts itself.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs can overwrite a tab, so check it adds rather than replaces.
